done_when: Close's review and plan reads do not wait for an agent place, and a test run limited to a few named test files does not wait for the test place

findings.body: Raise: Functional — A single pytest command can collect more than the five files counted for admission. In a repo whose `test` command is `pytest tests src --doctest-modules`, changing five `test_*.py` files makes `few_tests` grant a free place at line 291. `fasttest.related` counts only `test_*.py` and `*_test.py` files (lines 280–283), while `narrow_command` preserves `--doctest-modules` and the `src` target (lines 57–86). The run can therefore execute the repo's source doctests while another test run holds the only place. Explicitly named test files outside those filename patterns have the same gap.
findings.title: Pytest doctests can bypass the test place despite an unrestricted run

stop.reason: Owner chose narrow: small test runs skip the test queue only when the test command has no doctest option; reviews and plan reads still skip the agent queue

why: A 2-minute review waits about 10 minutes for an agent place and a worker's small test run queues for the single test place
